teaser.en: Pumpkins on the coast often sprout from rubbish heaps, where a few thrown-out seeds turn into a sprawling vine.
teaser.sw: Pwani, maboga mara nyingi huota kwenye majaa, ambapo mbegu chache zilizotupwa hugeuka kuwa mtambaa unaoenea kila upande.
teaser.dg: Pwani, mara nyinji madzungu ganamera madzalani, phatu tembe chache zirizotsuphwa zinakala mmea mure unaoambala na kuenea.

summary.en: *Dzungu* is the pumpkin, a trailing vine with large fruits grown on farms and around homes. Both the fruit and the leaves are eaten.
summary.sw: *Dzungu* ni boga, mmea unaotambaa wenye matunda makubwa, unaopandwa mashambani na kuzunguka nyumba. Tunda na majani yake huliwa.
summary.dg: *Dzungu* ni mmea unaoambala photsi wenye matunda makulu, unaorimwa mindani na kanda-kanda ya midzi. Tunda na makodza, vyosi viiri nkuriwa.

about.en: The pumpkin is a vigorous trailing vine with large, rough, lobed leaves, coiling tendrils and big yellow trumpet-shaped flowers. The fruits are large and vary in shape and colour, with thick, orange flesh around a hollow full of flat seeds.
about.sw: Boga ni mtambaa wenye nguvu, wenye majani makubwa, makwaruzu na yenye pindo, mikonyo inayojisokota, na maua makubwa ya manjano yenye umbo la tarumbeta. Matunda yake ni makubwa na hutofautiana kwa umbo na rangi, yakiwa na nyama nene ya rangi ya chungwa inayozunguka uwazi uliojaa mbegu bapa.
about.dg: *Dzungu* ni mmea wenye nguvu unaoambala photsi, wenye makodza makulu ganayokaraza na ganayoganywa seemu-seemu, milita midide inayolinga-linga, na maruwa makulu ga rangi ya mandano ga umbo ra tarumbeta. Matunda ni makulu, ga maumbo na rangi za tafwauti, na nyama ndziho ya rangi ya chungbwa inazunguluka phatu phahuphu kahi-kahi phenye tembe nyinji za bapa.

where.en: Pumpkins grow on farms and on rubbish heaps, where the rich soil suits them.
where.sw: Maboga hukua mashambani na kwenye majaa, ambapo udongo wenye rutuba huyafaa.
where.dg: Madzungu ganamera mindani na madzalani, phatu ulongo unono unaphogafwaha.

uses.en: The fruit is cooked with coconut milk, and the leaves are eaten as a vegetable.
uses.sw: Tunda lake hupikwa kwa tui la nazi, na majani yake huliwa kama mboga.
uses.dg: Tunda nkujitwa na huwi, na makodza nkuriwa dza mboga.

names.en: Mgombato gives *dzungu* for the pumpkin, while Pakia records the plant as *mrenje*. Swahili calls it *boga*; Mgombato's own Swahili gloss is *tango pepeta*. In English it is pumpkin.
names.sw: Mgombato inatoa *dzungu* kwa boga, ilhali Pakia inaurekodi mmea huu kama *mrenje*. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *boga*; tafsiri ya Kiswahili ya Mgombato yenyewe ni *tango pepeta*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *pumpkin*.
names.dg: Mgombato anapha dzina *dzungu* kpwa tunda hiri, na Pakia anauandika mmea dza *mrenje*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *boga*, ela Mgombato anaandika neno ra Chiswahili *tango pepeta*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *pumpkin*.

reason.en: Another leaf vegetable cooked with coconut milk
reason.sw: Mboga nyingine ya majani inayopikwa kwa tui la nazi
reason.dg: Mboga yanjina ya makodza inayojitwa na huwi

reason.en: Its milk is what pumpkin is cooked in
reason.dg: Nazi za *mnazi* ndizo zinazolavya huwi ra kujitira dzungu
